_note: MOCK DATA – fictional, for a student prototype

requests.question: An earlier computing class had no remaining seats. How was the student advised?
requests.root_cause: The section has reached its capacity.
requests.resolution: Join the waiting list or choose an available section.

requests.question: A previous business student had a balance-related registration hold. How was it cleared?
requests.root_cause: An unpaid balance has placed a registration hold.
requests.resolution: Resolve the balance and ask for the hold to be cleared.

requests.question: An earlier software course overlapped a laboratory class. What timetable adjustment helped?
requests.root_cause: The chosen section overlaps an existing registration.
requests.resolution: Choose a section with a different timetable.

requests.question: How did an advisor resolve a previous attempt to take more than the normal semester credits?
requests.root_cause: The new course would exceed 18 credits.
requests.resolution: Review the course load with an advisor.

requests.question: An earlier nursing student had passed the prerequisite but still needed academic approval. What resolved the hold?
requests.root_cause: Academic approval has not been recorded.
requests.resolution: Meet the advisor and request approval.

requests.question: An earlier nursing skills applicant had not passed the foundations course. What was required?
requests.root_cause: The prerequisite NUR101 had not been passed.
requests.resolution: Complete NUR101 and ask the advisor to review eligibility for NUR210.

requests.question: A previous nursing placement application arrived after registration closed. Who reviewed it?
requests.root_cause: The attempt arrived after the published registration deadline.
requests.resolution: Ask the registrar about late-registration approval; a request does not guarantee registration.
